The [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Ururur]] was the leader of a '''tribe'''<ref name="JKTCG" /> indigenous to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="BtM" /> As a tribe leader, Ururur made harsh laws with severe penalties, as it was the only way to maintain control.<ref name="JKTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ururur's tribe was created for their leader's card in the [[2001]] [[Masters of the Force (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Masters of the Force'']] expansion set of the ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="JKTCG" />
